content:
Ava R: Heads-up from UX review: alert preview feels ambiguous about order. users expect "priority" but we render by last-updated. saw a customer bug about expecting pager first. Jon P: Yep. two mental models colliding. option A: show user-configured priority. option B: show actual dispatch sequence with a label. Samira V: For accessibility it's critical the visual order matches what screenreaders announce. don't let CSS reordering change reading order. Theo B: Backend note: runtime may insert fallback targets (eg fallback.email) after first failure, so dispatch != static priority. Ava R: Proposal: show dispatch order in preview, but clearly label it "Dispatch order (first sent -> last)" and include a short inline explanation. Jon P: I like that. also show suppressed channels but greyed and annotated "suppressed until 3:42pm". admins need to verify suppression is active. Samira V: Agree on greyed rows. make suppression label machine-readable and provide aria-describedby pointing to the suppression reason. contrast must stay AA. Ava R: Copy suggestion for aria-live: "This alert will notify PagerDuty, then Slack, then Email. suppressed: Ops-email until 15:42." Theo B: Small API change request: include a "preview_sequence" array with objects {id, name, state, suppressed_until_relative}. frontend can render without client-side re-sort. Jon P: If adding API fields is heavy, fallback is front-end to map runtime order but still surface a tooltip: "Why this order?" linking to routing docs. keep tooltip copy short. Samira V: Keyboard flow: when entering preview, focus should land on the summary sentence (aria-live) and allow arrow keys to traverse channels. pressing Enter on a suppressed channel should open suppression details. Ava R: Visual: add a tiny numeric pill for priority (only for context) and ensure it has a sr-only label like "priority two". avoid making pill the primary order cue. deploy-bot: FYI deployment window for console flag: Tue 8pm PDT -> feature-flag required. see https://go/redwood/console/preview-order-rollout Theo B: For SR copy use relative time: "suppressed for 2h 13m" not raw ISO. include both iso & relative in API. Jon P: Minimal aria snippet we can reuse: ```
This alert will notify: PagerDuty, then Slack, then Email. Suppressed: Ops-email for 2h 13m.
``` Samira V: Also test with NVDA & VoiceOver on mac. I'll add an accessibility test case to the design checklist. Ava R: I'll mock two variants (dispatch-labeled + priority-labeled) and post images. tagging @Samira V and @Jon P for quick thumbs. :sparkles:
